resources.string:
Your videos never leave your device: recordings are written straight into the folder you choose, and the app has no account, no analytics and no crash reporting of its own.

This free version shows ads from Google AdMob. To serve them, Google may use your device's advertising ID and approximate location, depending on the choice you make in the consent message. If you are in the EEA, the UK or Switzerland you can review or change that choice at any time under "Ad privacy settings" on the main screen. A one-time purchase removes all ads, and the ad SDK is then never started.

Only the permissions required for recording are requested: camera, microphone (only when audio recording is enabled), notifications for the recording indicator, and a wake lock so that recording continues while the screen is off. The network permission is used only for ads and for the purchase.
This app is open source. The build published on F-Droid and GitHub contains no ads, no billing and no network access at all; this Google Play build adds ads and a one-time \"remove ads\" purchase.
